title: conradina canescens
intro: Conradina canescens, commonly known as the Gray Hillside Bush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is a shrubby plant native to the southeastern United States, known for its small white or pale yellow flowers. The health benefits of Conradina canescens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress.
